userStories.title: Retire the inert review gate knob with a warning
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Remove the inert review gate knob while warning users who still configure it.

**Motivation** — Setting it to `false` changes nothing and warns nothing.

**Approach** — Retire `review.gateLLMChecksOnMechanicalPass` (#2174)

- Delete the key from `ReviewConfigSchema` (`src/config/schemas-review.ts`), from the default config (`src/config/schemas.ts`) and from `ReviewConfig` (`src/review/types.ts`).
- Delete `skipped?: boolean` from `ReviewCheckResult` (`src/review/types.ts`).
- Add `"review.gateLLMChecksOnMechanicalPass"` to `REMOVED_NO_OP_KEYS` (`src/config/config-guards.ts`) with the hint `LLM review checks are sequenced by the story orchestrator; this key never had an effect after #1859`. `stripRemovedNoOpKeys` then warns once and strips the key, as it does for the existing entries.
- Fix the LLM row of the table in `docs/guides/semantic-review.md` to drop the gating clause.
- Removal of the three declarations and of `skipped` is verified by the build (`bun run typecheck`) and the existing lint gate, not by an AC.

**Scope** — In: guarded removal, loader compatibility, obsolete-test update and guide row. Out: implementing the gate in the story orchestrator (issue Option B); editing the historical story-orchestrator spec.
acceptanceCriteria: When stripRemovedNoOpKeys({ review: { gateLLMChecksOnMechanicalPass: false, enabled: true } }, warn) runs, then the returned review has no gateLLMChecksOnMechanicalPass key (checked with `in`).
When stripRemovedNoOpKeys({ review: { gateLLMChecksOnMechanicalPass: false, enabled: true } }, warn) runs, then the returned review has enabled: true.

When stripRemovedNoOpKeys receives a review with gateLLMChecksOnMechanicalPass: false, then warn is invoked exactly once with a message containing review.gateLLMChecksOnMechanicalPass and `has been removed`.
When stripRemovedNoOpKeys processes an input with review.gateLLMChecksOnMechanicalPass: false, then that input still has review.gateLLMChecksOnMechanicalPass === false afterwards.
When NaxConfigSchema.parse parses a config with review: {}, then the parsed review has no gateLLMChecksOnMechanicalPass key (checked with `in`).
When the config loader loads a project whose .nax/config.json sets review.gateLLMChecksOnMechanicalPass: true, then loading succeeds and the loaded review has no gateLLMChecksOnMechanicalPass key.

routing.reasoning: Removing three declarations and using the established warn-and-strip config guard is standard cross-file maintenance with one loader-compatibility check.

outOfScope: implementing the gate in the story orchestrator (issue Option B).

modifiedFiles.reason: the assertions that `gateLLMChecksOnMechanicalPass` parses and round-trips are deleted with the key.

userStories.title: Expose rotated findings and name oscillation counts accurately
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Record full finding replacement as `rotated` and describe oscillation counts as reappearing sources.

**Motivation** — The breaker reason says `N regressed-different-source iterations`, but the count is the number of finding sources that reappeared after being resolved; `classifyOutcome` returns `regressed` for both partial novelty and full replacement.

**Approach** — `rotated` outcome and an honest breaker reason (#2154 secondary defects)

`src/findings/cycle.ts` is at 592 of 600 lines, so `classifySingleSource` and `classifyOutcome` move verbatim into a new module `src/findings/classify-outcome.ts`; `cycle.ts` imports `classifyOutcome` from it for its own call sites and re-exports it (`export { classifyOutcome } from "./classify-outcome";`) so every existing import keeps working.

`IterationOutcome` (`src/findings/cycle-types.ts`) gains `"rotated"`, and the inline copy of the union at `src/plugins/builtin/curator/types.ts` gains it too.

In `classifyOutcome`, after the `regressed-different-source` check and before the per-source aggregation:

```ts
// nax#2154: every finding replaced by a different one — the defect moved, nothing converged.
const beforeKeys = new Set(before.map(findingRecurrenceKey));
if (after.length > 0 && after.every((f) => !beforeKeys.has(findingRecurrenceKey(f)))) return "rotated";
```

Precedence is therefore: `resolved` (both empty) → `regressed` (before empty) → `regressed-different-source` → `rotated` → per-source aggregation (unchanged). No consumer treats `rotated` specially: `countOscillationOutcomes` works on sources, not outcomes, and the curator, `prior-iterations-builder.ts` and `no-progress-bail.ts` only special-case `resolved` or `unchanged`.

The breaker reason in `src/execution/oscillation-breaker.ts` becomes:

```ts
reason: `Rectification oscillation threshold reached: ${count} resolved finding sources reappeared across attempts (max ${maxOscillations})`,
```

The `countOscillationOutcomes` comment in `src/execution/post-run.ts` that calls the count
"regressed-different-source iterations" is corrected to the same wording.

**Scope** — In: classifier extraction, outcome unions, breaker reason and misleading post-run comment. Out: feeding `rotated` into the oscillation count; counting consecutive rotated iterations toward the breaker; growing baseline-sized `test/unit/findings/cycle.test.ts`.

**Interface** — `classifyOutcome<F extends Finding>(before: F[], after: F[]): IterationOutcome` remains exported from cycle and the findings barrel and is also exported from the new module.
acceptanceCriteria: When classifyOutcome from src/findings/classify-outcome.ts receives four before findings (semantic at lines 114, 114 with a different rule, 121, and adversarial at 108) and two after semantic findings at lines 96 and 76, then it returns 'rotated'.
When classifyOutcome receives semantic at a.ts:10 before and semantic at a.ts:20 after, then it returns 'rotated'.
When classifyOutcome receives semantic at a.ts:10 and a.ts:20 before and semantic at a.ts:20 and a.ts:30 after, then it returns 'regressed' (one key persisted).
When classifyOutcome receives semantic at a.ts:10 before and adversarial at a.ts:10 after, then it returns 'regressed-different-source' (the new-source check takes precedence over rotated).
When classifyOutcome receives the same semantic file, line and rule before and after but a different message, then it returns 'unchanged' (nax#1581 preserved).
When classifyOutcome receives an empty before and one after finding, then it returns 'regressed'.
When classifyOutcome receives empty before and after findings, then it returns 'resolved'.
When classifyOutcome is imported from src/findings/cycle.ts and from src/findings for the four-to-two rotation case, then each returns the same result as the src/findings/classify-outcome.ts export.
When the oscillation breaker trips with recorded count 2 and maxOscillations 2, then its reason contains '2 resolved finding sources reappeared'.
When the oscillation breaker trips with recorded count 2 and maxOscillations 2, then its reason does not contain 'regressed-different-source'.

routing.reasoning: The near-limit classifier extraction changes outcome precedence and a duplicated serialized union while retaining barrel and breaker compatibility across modules.

modifiedFiles.reason: a reason-text assertion naming `regressed-different-source` (if any) is updated to the new wording; the count and case-insensitive "oscillat" substring assertions are unchanged.

userStories.title: Stop slow spins on time and replenish episode nudges
userStories.description:
**Goal** — End repeated slow tool-call spins as fail-spin before idle watchdog cancellation and restore nudge warnings after sustained new work.

**Motivation** — A repeated call that takes ~40 s reaches the watchdog first, and the cancel is classified `fail-stale` instead of `fail-spin`; the breaker's nudge budget is spent once per session and never restored.

**Approach** — Spin breaker time axis and per-episode nudge budget (#2017)

`ResolvedSpinBreakerSettings` (`src/runtime/spin-breaker/index.ts`) gains:

```ts
/**
 * nax#2017: seconds with no new call key after which a repeat run ends the turn, so a slow spin
 * stops as fail-spin before the tool-call-only idle watchdog cancels it as fail-stale. 0 disables.
 */
readonly stopAfterNoProgressSeconds: number;
```

`DEFAULT_SPIN_BREAKER_SETTINGS.stopAfterNoProgressSeconds` is `900`.
`AgentSpinBreakerConfigSchema` (`src/config/schemas-infra.ts`) gains
`stopAfterNoProgressSeconds: z.number().int().min(0).max(86_400).optional()` — optional, no zod
default, because the effective default depends on another section. The schema is module-private
today; it becomes `export const AgentSpinBreakerConfigSchema` so its validation can be tested
directly (it is not added to the `src/config/index.ts` barrel). `AgentSpinBreakerConfig` gains
the matching optional field.

`selectSpinBreakerSettings` (`src/session/spin-breaker-selection.ts`) resolves it as: the configured
value when set; otherwise `Math.floor(t / 2)` where `t` is
`config.agent.idleWatchdog.toolCallOnlyIdleTimeoutSeconds`, when the watchdog `mode` is not `"off"`
and `t > 0`; otherwise `900`.

`createSpinBreaker(settings, deps?)` gains an optional second parameter
`{ readonly now?: () => number }` (milliseconds, default `Date.now`). The breaker keeps
`lastProgressAt`, set to `now()` at creation and on every new-key event.

`SpinStopReason` gains `"no-progress-time"`, with stop message
`"Ending the turn — repeated calls with no new call for too long"`. In `observe`, on the repeat path,
after `repeatsSinceProgress` is incremented and before the `repeat-run` threshold check:

```ts
const NO_PROGRESS_TIME_MIN_REPEATS = 5;
if (
  settings.stopAfterNoProgressSeconds > 0 &&
  repeatsSinceProgress >= NO_PROGRESS_TIME_MIN_REPEATS &&
  now() - lastProgressAt >= settings.stopAfterNoProgressSeconds * 1000
) {
  return stopOrNudge(toolName, repeatsSinceProgress, "no-progress-time");
}
```

`NO_PROGRESS_TIME_MIN_REPEATS` is a module constant, not a setting. The stop reaches the
orchestrator through the existing `spinStopped` → `fail-spin` path; no session, adapter or
`src/session/manager.ts` change.

Nudge budget: the breaker keeps two counters. `nudges` stays the session-cumulative count that
`summary()` reports (telemetry meaning unchanged). A new internal `episodeNudges` is what
`stopOrNudge`, the nudge-point check and `nudgeText` use against `maxNudges`. `episodeNudges` resets
to `0` when a real stop fires, and when `newKeyEvents - newKeyEventsAtLastNudge >=
settings.nudgeAfterRepeats` on a new-key event (`newKeyEventsAtLastNudge` is recorded in
`buildNudge`). Resetting on every new key is deliberately NOT done: a laundering loop that
interleaves a fresh key between repeats of one call (nax#2047) would restore its budget forever and
never stop.

**Scope** — In: optional config, watchdog-derived resolution, injectable clock, time stop, per-episode budget and regression tests. Out: relabelling watchdog cancels in `src/session/watchdog-turn-classification.ts`; editing `src/session/manager.ts`; resetting budget on each fresh call.

**Interface** — `createSpinBreaker(settings: ResolvedSpinBreakerSettings, deps?: { readonly now?: () => number }): SpinBreaker`; `SpinStopReason` includes `"no-progress-time"`.
acceptanceCriteria: When createSpinBreaker({ ...DEFAULT_SPIN_BREAKER_SETTINGS, stopAfterNoProgressSeconds: 900 }, { now }) observes A at now = 0 and eight further A calls at now = 1,000,000 ms without noteResult, then repeats 1-4 return allow, repeats 5-7 return nudge, and repeat 8 returns stop with reason 'no-progress-time'.
When a fresh breaker with those settings observes A then eight repeats of A at now = 899,000 ms, then none of those repeats returns stop or nudge (below the time limit, below nudgeAfterRepeats).

When a breaker observes A at 0, then repeats A at 1,000,000 ms with a new key B after the third repeat, then no 'no-progress-time' verdict occurs within four further A repeats (the new key reset the clock and repeat count).
When stopAfterNoProgressSeconds is 0 and a breaker observes A then 20 repeats at 10,000,000 ms, then none returns nudge or stop (time axis disabled; below the repeat thresholds).
selectSpinBreakerSettings returns stopAfterNoProgressSeconds: 600 when the agent idle watchdog toolCallOnlyIdleTimeoutSeconds is 1200.
selectSpinBreakerSettings returns stopAfterNoProgressSeconds: 300 when agent.spinBreaker.stopAfterNoProgressSeconds is 300 and watchdog timeout is 1200.
selectSpinBreakerSettings returns stopAfterNoProgressSeconds: 900 when idle watchdog mode is 'off' and no configured stopAfterNoProgressSeconds is set.
selectSpinBreakerSettings returns stopAfterNoProgressSeconds: 900 when config is undefined.

When settings returned by selectSpinBreakerSettings with watchdog toolCallOnlyIdleTimeoutSeconds: 1200 are passed to createSpinBreaker with an injected clock, then call A's repeat run stops with reason 'no-progress-time' when repeats are observed at 601,000 ms.
AgentSpinBreakerConfigSchema rejects stopAfterNoProgressSeconds: -1.
AgentSpinBreakerConfigSchema accepts stopAfterNoProgressSeconds: 0.
When the laundering loop [A, B, A, B, ...] calls noteResult(..., 'identical') after each call, then it still stops at call 28 with summary().nudges equal to 3 (unchanged).
When a breaker repeats A with noteResult(..., 'identical') and a never-before-seen key between every two A calls, then it stops with reason 'same-key-cumulative'.

When a breaker repeats A with noteResult(..., 'identical') and a never-before-seen key between every two A calls, then summary().nudges is 3 at that stop (a fresh interleaved key does not restore the budget).

When createSpinBreaker(DEFAULT_SPIN_BREAKER_SETTINGS, { now: () => 0 }) observes A once, 42 repeats of A without noteResult (nudges at default repeat points 25, 33 and 42), 25 distinct new keys, and 25 repeats of the last new key, then its 25th repeat returns a nudge with nudgeNumber 1.

When createSpinBreaker(DEFAULT_SPIN_BREAKER_SETTINGS, { now: () => 0 }) observes A once, 42 repeats of A without noteResult (nudges at default repeat points 25, 33 and 42), 25 distinct new keys, and 25 repeats of the last new key, then summary().nudges is 4.
When a breaker reaches a real stop and then a different key's repeat run reaches nudgeAfterRepeats, then that next run returns a nudge (not a stop).

routing.reasoning: Multi-axis session-scoped stop accounting and nudge telemetry affect failure classification and require isolated verification of laundering-loop regressions.

modifiedFiles.reason: an exact-equality assertion over the resolved settings gains `stopAfterNoProgressSeconds`.

an exact-equality assertion over `DEFAULT_SPIN_BREAKER_SETTINGS` or a settings fixture gains `stopAfterNoProgressSeconds`; the laundering test's `stoppedAt` (28) and `nudges` (3) expectations are unchanged.

userStories.title: Label post-run approval and retry prompts honestly
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Label post-run approval prompts by their actual stage and non-timeout retries by their actual failure, while pinning runner chain forwarding.

**Motivation** — `createHumanAskLink` hard-codes `stage: "execution"` on every approval prompt; `timeoutRetry` tells a `fail-spin` or `fail-incomplete` retry that it "hit a timeout"; runner interaction-chain threading has no test.

**Approach** — #2213 leftovers: approval stage, retry wording, runner test

**Approval stage.** `createHumanAskLink` (`src/interaction/ask-link.ts`) options gain
`readonly stage?: InteractionStage`; the prompt uses `stage: opts.stage ?? "execution"`.
`DispatchAskOptions` (`src/interaction/dispatch-ask.ts`) gains `readonly stage?: InteractionStage`,
and `buildDispatchAskWiring` passes it to `deps.createHumanAskLink` when defined.
`buildRunDispatchAskWiring` forwards it through its existing spread. Post-run callers pass the
existing `InteractionStage` values (no new union members):
- `src/execution/lifecycle/acceptance-fix-scope.ts` → `"review"`
- `src/execution/lifecycle/run-regression.ts` (deferred regression gate) → `"review"`
- `src/finish/phase.ts` → `"merge"`
- `src/pipeline/stages/execution.ts` passes nothing (keeps `"execution"`).

**Retry wording.** `timeoutRetry` dispatches `fail-spin` and `fail-incomplete` to their own
builders, as it already does for `fail-invalid-tool-call`. `fail-spin`, `fail-incomplete`, `fail-invalid-tool-call` and `fail-timeout` all share the `timeout` retry lane in `src/agents/retry/failure-policy.ts` (read-only context; not edited), which is why all four reach `timeoutRetry`. Both keep the structure of
`invalidToolCallRetry`: a first line naming what happened, the line
`This was not a timeout. This is attempt N of the same story.`, a change-of-approach line, the
changed-files state paragraph, then `---` and the original prompt.
- `fail-spin` first line: `The previous attempt was stopped because it kept repeating the same tool calls without making progress.`
  Approach line: `Do not repeat a call whose result you already have; if a check keeps returning the same result, change the code or the approach before running it again.`
- `fail-incomplete` first line: `The previous attempt ended its turn before finishing the story.`
  Approach line: `Keep working until every acceptance criterion is met, then finish with your final answer.`
`fail-timeout` and an absent `failure` keep today's wording byte-for-byte.

**Runner test.** A test pins that `run` passes its interaction chain into
`_runnerDeps.runCompletionPhase` unchanged.

**Scope** — In: stage forwarding in ask link/dispatch and three post-run callers, two non-timeout retry variants, runner chain identity regression test. Out: extending `InteractionStage`; editing dead-in-production AcpInteractionBridge; addressing git-spawn-env blind spot.

**Interface** — `createHumanAskLink` options gain `readonly stage?: InteractionStage`; `DispatchAskOptions` gains `readonly stage?: InteractionStage`.
acceptanceCriteria: When createHumanAskLink({ chain, timeoutMs: 1000, stage: 'review' }) prompts a recording chain, then the sent request's stage is 'review'.
When createHumanAskLink({ chain, timeoutMs: 1000 }) prompts a recording chain, then the sent request's stage is 'execution'.
When buildDispatchAskWiring is called with stage: 'merge' and a recording deps.createHumanAskLink, then that dependency receives stage: 'merge'.
When buildDispatchAskWiring is called without stage and a recording deps.createHumanAskLink, then the passed options contain no stage key.
When buildRunDispatchAskWiring is called with stage: 'review', then deps.createHumanAskLink receives stage: 'review'.
When acceptance-fix scope runs with a recording _acceptanceFixScopeDeps.buildRunDispatchAskWiring, then it calls that dependency with stage: 'review'.
When the deferred regression gate runs with a recording _regressionDeps.buildRunDispatchAskWiring, then it calls that dependency with stage: 'review'.
When finish phase runs with a recording _finishPhaseDeps.buildRunDispatchAskWiring, then it calls that dependency with stage: 'merge'.

When timeoutRetry receives failure.outcome 'fail-spin', changedFiles ['src/a.ts'], attempt 1 and prompt P, then its text contains 'kept repeating the same tool calls', 'This was not a timeout. This is attempt 2 of the same story.', '- src/a.ts' and P.
When timeoutRetry receives failure.outcome 'fail-spin', changedFiles ['src/a.ts'], attempt 1 and prompt P, then its text does not contain 'hit a timeout'.

When timeoutRetry receives failure.outcome 'fail-incomplete' and empty changedFiles, then its text contains 'ended its turn before finishing the story', 'This was not a timeout.' and 'The previous attempt left no file changes on disk.'.
When timeoutRetry receives failure.outcome 'fail-incomplete' and empty changedFiles, then its text does not contain 'hit a timeout'.
When timeoutRetry receives failure.outcome 'fail-timeout', then its text still starts with 'The previous attempt hit a timeout after'.
When timeoutRetry receives no failure, then its text still starts with 'The previous attempt hit a timeout after'.

When run from src/execution/runner.ts receives an interaction chain object C and a recording _runnerDeps.runCompletionPhase, then it calls runCompletionPhase with options.interactionChain identical to C (same reference, toBe).

routing.reasoning: The approval ask link is a human authorization surface; strict test isolation protects stage/default behavior while several call sites and retry builders change.

modifiedFiles.reason: an exact-equality assertion over the options passed to `createHumanAskLink` may gain `stage` only where the test passes one.
gains the interaction-chain threading test (278 lines before the change; stays well under 800).

analysis: Five independent TypeScript/Bun changes; no story dependencies. US-001: src/config/schemas-review.ts:237, src/config/schemas.ts:249, and src/review/types.ts:297 declare/default/type a key that no live check reads; src/review/types.ts:148 has the orphaned ReviewCheckResult.skipped. src/config/config-guards.ts:269-302 defines REMOVED_NO_OP_KEYS and :320-369 immutably strips and warns once per present key; src/config/loader.ts:244-267 strips after merging and before Zod safeParse, :519,:573 handles package configs. Preserve warn-and-load, not reject or silent Zod stripping. docs/guides/semantic-review.md:230 makes a false claim; test/unit/config/semantic-review.test.ts:137-162 still asserts the old default/override and must be revised. US-002: src/runtime/packages.ts:11-29 defines PackageView, :61-87 constructs it, :132-210 hydrates mergedConfigs, caches views, normalizes worktree override lookup and invalidates cached identities; preserve the same keying for a second raw-overlay map and leave overlay key absent on no-file views. src/config/merge.ts:126-145 bridges per-package quality commands into merged review commands; src/quality/command-resolver.ts:65-97 prefers review.commands.test and can promote scoped orchestrator commands. Consequently merged config/hasOverride cannot identify the raw source of an individual gate command. src/operations/lint-check.ts:97-134 and typecheck-check.ts:106-134 detect missing commands, while verify-scoped.ts:141-147,:234-249 and full-suite-gate.ts:155-189 choose cwd; replace hasOverride cwd tests without changing missing-command skip/error semantics. full-suite-gate.ts:128-132 defines FullSuiteGateContext, :314-317 logs the command cwd; detected full-suite return should also report detected provenance. The src/runtime/packages.ts:15-22 repoRoot comment warns about main-checkout writes under isolation; use precisely the spec's root-vs-workdir rule only at the specified gate sites, not for unrelated Exec/git. Existing operation routing fixtures need raw overlays defining the actual command. US-003: src/findings/cycle.ts:59-113 implements both classifiers at 592/600 lines; :447,:557 calls classifyOutcome. Extract them and re-export via cycle to preserve src/findings/index.ts:29 and src/review/review-iteration-store.ts:2,50 imports. src/findings/cycle-types.ts:17-22 and src/plugins/builtin/curator/types.ts:193 duplicate the outcome union; both need rotated. src/findings/types.ts:260-288 defines message-excluding findingRecurrenceKey. src/execution/oscillation-store.ts:46-63 counts previously resolved finding SOURCE reappearances, not iterations; src/execution/oscillation-breaker.ts:52 and src/execution/post-run.ts:355 mislabel them. Keep the separate counter unchanged. test/unit/findings/cycle.test.ts is baseline 933 lines: new classifier tests belong in a new file. US-004: src/runtime/spin-breaker/index.ts:25-69 contains resolved settings, default and reason union; :217-378 owns bounded per-key state, cumulative nudges, nudge points, stopOrNudge and observe. Add clock and repeat-time check after increment, before repeat-run stop; reset ONLY episode nudge budget on real stop or enough distinct new-key events since last nudge, never on each new key. src/config/schemas-infra.ts:226-258 defines watchdog schema/defaults, :262-306 defines spin schema; optional time knob has no Zod default. src/config/runtime-types-agent.ts:130-148 defines optional settings; src/session/spin-breaker-selection.ts:17-27 resolves concrete transport-neutral settings. src/agents/native/session/turn-result.ts:43 already routes spinStopped into fail-spin; no adapter/session manager change. test/unit/runtime/spin-breaker.test.ts:242-256 pins the laundering stop at call 28 and cumulative 3 nudges; test/unit/session/spin-breaker-selection.test.ts:14 pins exact settings. US-005: src/interaction/types.ts:11 already offers review and merge stages; src/interaction/ask-link.ts:58-72 accepts narrow AskChannel options but :103-110 hard-codes execution on the human-facing prompt. src/interaction/dispatch-ask.ts:64-85 declares options, :112-138 constructs the link, :248-262 already spreads run opts; pass stage only if defined. src/execution/lifecycle/acceptance-fix-scope.ts:45, run-regression.ts:452, and src/finish/phase.ts:290 own post-run wiring; the execution-stage caller should stay untouched. src/prompts/builders/timeout-retry-builder.ts:38-65 handles timeout and :71-99 handles invalid calls; new spin/incomplete variants reuse changed-file state semantics while timeout/no-failure text stays byte-identical. src/execution/runner.ts:330-363 already forwards interactionChain into runCompletionPhase; test/unit/execution/runner-total.test.ts should assert object identity without changing production runner. Migration: retire inert review key with one warning and successful config load; optional spin time defaults to watchdog half-time or 900; serialized finding outcome vocabulary gains rotated, with source-based breaker semantics preserved. Risks are warning placement before Zod strip, distinguishing raw overlays from inherited/bridged commands, classification precedence and message-insensitive identity, laundering loops restoring warnings endlessly, telemetry staying cumulative, and changing prompt presentation without changing permission verdicts.
outOfScope: #2154's primary change (counting consecutive rotated iterations toward the oscillation breaker) is not done; it needs a base-rate measurement first.
#2017's alternative of relabelling a watchdog cancel as `fail-spin` in `src/session/watchdog-turn-classification.ts` is not done.
#2182's log-only alternative is not done; the provenance rule replaces the `hasOverride` ternary.
#2213 item 3 (`scripts/check-git-spawn-env.ts` blind spot) is not done: no git spawn in `src/` builds its argv from a git-binary identifier, and the four variable-argv sites are already hardened.
New `InteractionStage` union members (`acceptance`, `rectification`) are not added.
`hasOverride` is not removed or renamed; its config-selection callers are unchanged.
The dead-in-production `AcpInteractionBridge` (`src/agents/acp/interaction-bridge.ts`) keeps its hard-coded stage.
The historical `docs/specs/SPEC-story-orchestrator.md` mention of the retired knob is not edited.
